description: Header file defining the DwarfLineToModule class, which processes DWARF line number data and integrates it into a google_breakpad::Module. It includes class declarations, member variables, and method signatures for handling source location info, directory and file definitions, and line addition.

classes.name: DwarfLineToModule
classes.description: A class that handles DWARF line number information, adding source location data to a Module and accumulating line info, with heuristics to omit certain lines starting at address zero.

methods.name: DefineDir
methods.description: Defines a directory with a name and directory number.

methods.name: DefineFile
methods.description: Defines a file with associated metadata such as name, file number, directory number, modification time, and length.

methods.name: AddLine
methods.description: Adds a line entry with address, length, file number, line number, and column number.
